mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comparison_runs (id, session_id, input_revision, assessment_date, calculation_version, status, input_snapshot, policy_snapshot, result_snapshot, calculated_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{inputRevision}, #{assessmentDate}, #{calculationVersion}, #{status}, CAST(#{inputSnapshot} AS jsonb), CAST(#{policySnapshot} AS jsonb), CAST(#{resultSnapshot} AS jsonb), #{calculatedAt}, now(), now())
